# unifi_setting_remote_syslog (Resource)

Manage a site's remote syslog server, the legacy local Network API setting `rsyslogd`. The setting exists once per site: the resource takes over the existing document, or creates it on a site that has never saved it, and changes only the fields it models. Each write sends the document back whole, to preserve the fields it doesn't model, so a field that was absent can become empty but never absent again. Import with `<site_id>`. Destroying the resource only removes it from Terraform state; logging stays as it is.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "unifi_site" "default" {
  name = "Default"
}

# Send device, client and firewall logs from every UniFi device to one syslog server.
resource "unifi_setting_remote_syslog" "default" {
  site_id  = data.unifi_site.default.id
  enabled  = true
  ip       = "192.0.2.10"
  port     = 514
  contents = ["device", "client", "firewall_default_policy", "security_detections"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enabled` (Boolean) Send the site's syslog (gateway, switches, access points) to a remote server.
- `site_id` (String) Integration site UUID.

### Optional

- `contents` (Set of String) Log categories to send, as the controller names them, for example `device`, `client`, `firewall_default_policy`, `security_detections`, `admin_activity`, `critical`, `triggers`, `updates` and `vpn`. Keeps the controller's value when not set.
- `ip` (String) IPv4 address of the syslog server. Required when `enabled` is true, unless the controller already has one. Keeps the controller's value when not set.
- `log_all_contents` (Boolean) Send every category (the UI's "all" option) instead of only `contents`. Keeps the controller's value when not set.
- `netconsole_enabled` (Boolean) Send the devices' kernel netconsole output too. Keeps the controller's value when not set.
- `port` (Number) UDP port of the syslog server, 1 to 65535. Keeps the controller's value when not set.
- `this_controller` (Boolean) Also send the logs to the console itself (controller field `this_controller`). Keeps the controller's value when not set.
- `this_controller_encrypted_only` (Boolean) Send logs to the console itself only over an encrypted connection (controller field `this_controller_encrypted_only`). Keeps the controller's value when not set.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Synthetic resource ID equal to `site_id`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The setting exists once per site: import with the integration site UUID.
terraform import unifi_setting_remote_syslog.default <site_id>
```
